assumptions: Illustrative educational thresholds, not validated aircraft engineering limits.

requirements.title: Persistent sensor disagreement
requirements.rationale: Software should recognize sustained conflicting sensor readings.
requirements.acceptance: When both samples are fresh and absolute difference is greater than 5000 mdegC for 500 ms continuously, transition NOMINAL to DEGRADED at the first eligible 100 ms tick.

result_evidence.note: Development tests cover detection and emitted transitions. Independent runtime requirement verdicts remain planned.

requirements.title: Stale sensor detection
requirements.rationale: Old measurements must not be treated as current evidence.
requirements.acceptance: A sample is stale when sim_time_ms - sample_time_ms > 300 ms. One stale sensor causes DEGRADED; both stale cause SAFE, at the first eligible tick after startup.

requirements.title: Low available battery
requirements.rationale: Insufficient power should cause a predictable conservative state.
requirements.acceptance: Available battery < 2000 basis points (20%) causes DEGRADED; < 1000 (10%) causes SAFE at the first eligible tick. SAFE takes precedence and latches until shutdown.

requirements.title: Validated configuration boundary
requirements.rationale: Reject unsupported or unbounded inputs before executing software behavior.
requirements.acceptance: Both validators accept only the four declared scenarios, schema 1.0, integer seed 0..4294967295, integer duration 1000..120000 ms divisible by 100, and fixed integer step 100 ms. Reject unknown fields, booleans/floats/strings for integer fields, and malformed JSON. C++ returns JSON error with exit 2; API returns HTTP 422 validation details. CLI caps input at 65536 bytes.

result_evidence.note: Reports are generated by actual execution and excluded from Git. This catalog is not a claim of a passing run.

requirements.title: Deterministic simulation
requirements.rationale: A failure should be reproducible from its input.
requirements.acceptance: Identical normalized configuration and simulator version produce byte-identical canonical simulation output, including stable content-derived run IDs and sequence-derived event IDs; wall-clock execution metadata is stored separately.

result_evidence.note: Replay covers healthy baseline and sensor disagreement; fixed byte snapshot covers baseline. Remaining scenarios and independent runtime checkers are planned.

requirements.title: Allowed state transitions
requirements.rationale: States make operating rules explicit and testable.
requirements.acceptance: All transitions follow docs/state-machine.md; no recovery from SAFE or automatic recovery from DEGRADED occurs within a run.

result_evidence.note: Policy, baseline and disagreement timing tested. Staleness, battery detection and independent runtime evaluation remain planned.
